cohort.coverage: all generated same-width/height coarse windows over the normalized image, no half-step/refinement or GT filtering

decision.scope: complete coarse-grid and matched source-position fixed single-image R1 feedback pilot only

limitations: The cohort is historically exposed and is not fresh confirmation.
Grid-oracle IoU is post-seal geometry headroom only; it did not enter prompts, rankings, or fitting.
A zero-IoU candidate grid means no positive reward exists within this finite grid; it does not establish that a continuous policy cannot fit.

Per-request timing covers model forward plus CUDA synchronization only, after PNG loading, preprocessing, and transfer; full end-to-end request and grid-preparation times are unknown. The separate worker launch-to-exit time includes model loading and all jobs.

local_policy_reward_diagnostic.scope: CPU32 fixed antithetic Gaussian samples per source, same samples IoU vs DIoU; no parameter fit/no efficacy claim

metrics.anchor_metric: single-frame continuous half-open xyxy IoU using source-pixel dimensions and HC2 lower-bound clipping consistent with the official dense evaluator
metrics.rank_ties: top-1 ties use earliest 1-based row-major window; Spearman uses average ranks for exact score ties

protocol_boundary: single still image per request, not the STVG-R1 native video/ID/temporal protocol; no multi-frame tube or tracking claim
scope: one source-frame anchor per historically exposed case; full same-scale coarse grid; original-minus-masked and marked-window teacher rankings
summary_text: Five of eight prelocked anchors have saved GT boxes (HC2 3, VidSTG 2); three remain unknown without GT-informed anchor replacement. All 184 categorical calls are sealed, including 24 separately declared source-position controls.

teacher_feedback_semantics.marked_score: marked-window support log odds; fixed visible ID 1 for every candidate
teacher_feedback_semantics.masking_response: unmarked original support score minus full-frame blurred-window support score; positive means hiding that window reduced measured support
